title: Archetype Mechanical Identity Expansion - Raw Tag Pruning Pass 1

policy.keep: Clearly reusable semantic, mechanical, or scope concept.
policy.delete: Structural, audit, bookkeeping, or implementation residue with no ontology value.
policy.reconsider: Potentially useful but ambiguous, compound, class/category/tree-derived, alias-like, too broad/narrow, or in need of decomposition.
policy.bespoke: Current singleton. One-use tags are quarantined by rule; they do not enter the shared ontology without explicit review.
policy.categoryAliasRule: All category_* tags go to RECONSIDER, never automatic DELETE, because they may encode latent mechanics that should be decomposed.
policy.singletonRule: Any tag with current talentCount === 1 goes to BESPOKE before any other rule.
policy.ontologyGoal: Remove noise and normalize meaning without optimizing for a small tag count.
